column12: Start (CHAOS, 151 vARB spots, Blue Tiger ramp). ATIS 374.375, GND 300.650, TWR 356.850. Hover-taxi; depart north under tower control. Transition leg 2.6 nm over Ramstein-Miesenbach - not terrain flight.
Start point (north gate): push time, start route timing; turn 53 deg right onto 052. Transition to LOW LEVEL (80-200 ft AHO). HELO common 75.500 FM1 (P8, datalink).
Open ground (281 m). Contour flight (25-80 ft AHO) over farmland; position report on HELO common (FM1 P8); turn 54 deg left onto 358.
Open high ground (326 m). Low level / contour as terrain dictates; practise mode transitions; turn 54 deg left onto 305.
Above the Glan/Lauter valleys (257 m). Masking and unmasking; cross the valley road at an angle; turn 53 deg left onto 252. Call SPADES 342.300 before the Baumholder area.
Release point (427 m), 4.1 nm NE of LZ ROBIN. Turn 25 deg left onto 227; NO further turns. NOE inbound (<=25 ft above vegetation).

LZ ROBIN: terrain-flight approach to an unimproved ridge-top LZ (415 m, ~1 deg slope, no structures within 800 m). Land, crew checks, terrain-flight takeoff to the SSE. Range 32B impact area is 6+ km N - stay S of it.
Start point for the return (261 m); turn 10 deg left onto 153. Call SPADES leaving the Baumholder area. Exfil differs from infil.
Open ground (292 m) E of Kusel. Contour flight; turn 23 deg left onto 129.
Open high ground (367 m); turn 0 deg right onto 130 toward the NW gate.
Recovery release point (NW gate) 3.2 nm from Ramstein. Call TWR 356.850; climb to pattern altitude; turn 14 deg right onto 144.
Approach and landing at Ramstein (151 vARB spots). Shutdown; Tacview debrief.
